Two independently driven wheels and passive caster. Equal speeds straight; different speeds curve; opposite directions called in-place, which needs equal magnitudes and ideal no slip. Figure labels driven and caster wheels.
v=r(omegaR+omegaL)/2; yaw=r(omegaR-omegaL)/L. Inputs angular wheel speeds; r radius and L spacing. Body diagram marks left/right and heading; ideal kinematic mapping, not measured slip.
